decision_basis.detail: The diagnostic runner did not verify supplied archives against the hashes declared by the frozen contract.
The diagnostic receipt did not prove that every audited source tree came from a fresh extraction of the declared archive.
The build receipt did not bind compiler, package, and environment versions tightly enough to establish fresh-build reproducibility.
The observed layout-filter count is retained only as a diagnostic observation and cannot authorize a scientific kill or promotion decision.

prohibited_claims: That source replay passed for the candidate
That all eligible instances built successfully
That the layout-stable confirmatory count is verified
That the candidate failed only its layout-unit floor
next_action: Return to wide topic search. Any future rerun must verify archive hashes before extraction, attest a fresh toolchain, and produce receipts bound to both the frozen contract and exact inputs.
